feeds.title: Export Solutions Blog
feeds.description: Export Solutions, Inc. is your 'In-House' trade compliance team - providing solutions to cover a full range of compliance activities. Our hands-on approach will take your compliance program from good to great as we take action on everything from large-scale, major operations, and even subtle tweaks with day-to-day activities.

feeds.title: Traliance Blog
feeds.description: Traliance provides export compliance consulting services to help research universities and technology companies comply with U.S. export controls regulations. Whether your organization is headquartered in the U.S. or has a parent company overseas, we'll determine how U.S. export control regulations apply to your business. Our consultants identify the relevant parts of the U.S. export control regulations - and then implement practical solutions to drive effective compliance that supports your organization's growth strategy.

feeds.title: SM Global Trade Law Blog » Export Controls
feeds.description: Sheppard Mullin is a full-service law firm with over 1000 attorneys working in 16 offices worldwide. We are a firm that truly puts clients first. And this sets us apart. We don't just give lip service to client service. Every attorney and staff member has a plaque in his/her work space listing what we, along with our clients, consider to be Service Essentials. In our Export Control blog get timely updates and analysis on key international trade law issues

feeds.title: Trade Win Blog
feeds.description: Established in 1997, Tradewin offers global trade compliance consulting and services. In more than two decades since opening its doors, Tradewin has earned a stellar reputation for global compliance expertise. At Tradewinds, our focus has always been solely on compliant trade regulation solutions with a global perspective and local expertise. We've helped thousands of importers and exporters around the world overcome trade compliance barriers, cross borders, and thrive in their sectors.

feeds.title: Baker McKenzie
feeds.description: Global Compliance News is a news platform for all compliance-related topics such as new legislation, important court decisions as well as decisions by public authorities that may have an impact on companies.

feeds.title: Export Compliance Training Institute
feeds.description: The Export Compliance Training Institute (ECTI, Inc.) provides comprehensive training programs on the reformed EAR, ITAR, and OFAC regulations for industry, government, and universities/research institutions. We also offer an expansive library of trade compliance webinars that explore more narrowly focused areas of international trade. International seminars for overseas companies cover U.S. regulations from a non-U.S. perspective.

feeds.title: WorldECR
feeds.description: We're a growing international community of thought leaders, practitioners, experts and policy makers, bringing together news, analysis and opinion on global export control and sanctions to any professional working in the field.Across the issues, across the globe, we are the resource you can't afford to be without.

feeds.title: Export Compliance Manager
feeds.description: Published ten times a year, Export Compliance Manager addresses the challenges faced by trade compliance professionals with insight and practical guidance. With contributions from leading advisors and thought-leaders and shared experiences from senior managers in the industry, Export Compliance Manager helps you deliver real commercial benefits to your organization.

feeds.title: Steptoe
feeds.description: The Steptoe International Compliance blog offers a fresh take on the issues that arise in the world of international regulatory enforcement and compliance, with a focus on the dynamic fields of export controls, economic sanctions, anti-corruption, and more.

feeds.title: CTP Blog
feeds.description: Commonwealth Trading Partners, Inc. (CTP) was founded in 1993 with the original goal of providing consulting services to U.S. Exporters. Our team of dedicated experts brings over twenty-five years of corporate experience in international trade and security domains supporting United States Government agencies and the private sector. We support national security efforts in the areas of export control, nonproliferation, border security, law enforcement, anti-terrorism, and anti-corruption.

feeds.title: Trademo Blog » Trade Compliance
feeds.description: Trademo is a Global Supply Chain Intelligence company that sources billions of supply chain data points and leverages AI to empower businesses with visibility, discover new commercial opportunities, ensure compliance with trade regulations, and build operational supply chain resilience. Browse through Trade Compliance to read articles and blog posts about tips and tricks for the trade.
